description: Precursor architecture figure and provenance artifact tables (evidence matrix, GO decision table)
code:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os, math
os.makedirs("provenance",exist_ok=True)
NLP29="MISTSSILVLVVLLACFMAASAQWGYGGYGRGYGGYGGYGRGMYGGYGRGMYGGYGRGMYGGYGRGMYGGWGK"
peps=[(23,29,"QWGYGGY"),(32,39,"GYGGYGGY"),(42,47,"GMYGGY"),(50,55,"GMYGGY"),(58,63,"GMYGGY"),(66,71,"GMYGGW")]
KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,K=-3.9,M=1.9,
        F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
chg={a:(1 if a in "KR" else (-1 if a in "DE" else 0)) for a in set(NLP29)}
n=len(NLP29); x=np.arange(1,n+1)

fig,axes=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(15,8.2),height_ratios=[1.25,1,1],sharex=True)
ax=axes[0]; ax.set_ylim(0,1); ax.axis("off")
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((1,0.55),22,0.3,color="#95A5A6"))
ax.text(12,0.70,"signal peptide 1-22",ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8.5,color="white")
for s,e,sq in peps:
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((s,0.55),e-s+1,0.3,color="#148F77"))
    ax.text((s+e)/2,0.70,sq,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=7.6,color="white")
    ax.text(e+0.5,0.42,"NH$_2$",fontsize=7,color="#148F77")
for i,a in enumerate(NLP29,1):
    if a in "KR":
        ax.plot([i],[0.50],marker="v",ms=7,color="#C0392B")
        ax.text(i,0.30,a+str(i),ha="center",fontsize=6.8,color="#C0392B")
    elif a=="G" and i<n and NLP29[i] in "KR":
        ax.plot([i],[0.90],marker="^",ms=6,color="#2471A3")
ax.text(1,0.12,"red triangles: Arg/Lys cleavage sites (consumed by processing)   blue triangles: Gly amide donors",
        fontsize=8,color="#444")
ax.set_title("NLP-29 (O44664) precursor architecture. All peptide and amidation features are UniProt ECO:0000255 predictions; protein existence PE=2",
             fontsize=10.5)

ax=axes[1]
cum=np.cumsum([chg[a] for a in NLP29])
ax.plot(x,cum,color="#6C3483",lw=2)
ax.fill_between(x,0,cum,color="#6C3483",alpha=0.18)
for s,e,_ in peps: ax.axvspan(s,e,color="#148F77",alpha=0.16)
ax.axvspan(1,22,color="#95A5A6",alpha=0.2)
ax.set_ylabel("cumulative\nside-chain charge")
ax.text(74,cum[-1],f"  pro-region net +{cum[22:].sum()/max(1,1):.0f}".replace(f"+{cum[22:].sum():.0f}",f"+{sum(chg[a] for a in NLP29[22:])}"),
        fontsize=8,color="#6C3483",va="center")
ax.annotate("every charged residue lies at a cleavage site,\nso processing removes all of the charge",
            xy=(57,4),xytext=(24,5.6),fontsize=8.5,color="#6C3483",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#6C3483",lw=1.2))
ax.grid(alpha=0.25)

ax=axes[2]
w=5; h=[np.mean([KD[a] for a in NLP29[max(0,i-w//2):i+w//2+1]]) for i in range(n)]
ax.plot(x,h,color="#B9770E",lw=1.8)
ax.axhline(0,color="grey",lw=0.8)
for s,e,_ in peps: ax.axvspan(s,e,color="#148F77",alpha=0.16)
ax.axvspan(1,22,color="#95A5A6",alpha=0.2)
ax.set_ylabel("Kyte-Doolittle\n(window 5)"); ax.set_xlabel("residue position")
ax.text(26,1.6,"the only hydrophobic stretch is the signal peptide;\nthe mature region is uniformly hydrophilic",fontsize=8.5,color="#B9770E")
ax.grid(alpha=0.25); ax.set_xlim(0,n+6)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# ---------------- Artifact tables ----------------
go_tbl=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(go_id="GO:0140912",aspect="MF",term="membrane destabilizing activity",current_evidence="NAS",
      reference="PMID:40226512",assigned_by="WB",
      finding="Cited paper is a knock-in NLP-29::mKate2 localization study with no membrane, liposome, permeabilization or killing assay. Predicted mature peptides have zero cationic side chains, muH 0.045-0.236, max extended length 20-27 A.",
      lead_action="REMOVE or demote to NOT-core; over-annotated",
      curator_note="If retained at all, restrict to the unprocessed pro-region (net +5.98) and flag as untested."),
 dict(go_id="GO:0061760",aspect="BP",term="antifungal innate immune response",current_evidence="IEP",
      reference="PMID:15048112",assigned_by="WB",
      finding="IEP is expression-pattern evidence. nlp-29(tm1931) null shows no change in D. coniospora resistance (PMID:18636113 full text). In vitro antifungal activity was shown for the paralog NLP-31, not NLP-29. Positive in vivo result is 6-gene cluster overexpression.",
      lead_action="RETAIN but mark non-core / involved_in with low confidence",
      curator_note="Gene-level contribution is not separable from the nlp-27..nlp-31 cluster."),
 dict(go_id="GO:0005576",aspect="CC",term="extracellular region",current_evidence="IDA + ISM + IEA",
      reference="PMID:40226512; PMID:11717458; GO_REF:0000044",assigned_by="WB; UniProt",
      finding="Knock-in translational reporter shows NLP-29::mKate2 secreted into the cuticle after genetic or physical damage. Signal peptide 1-22 predicted.",
      lead_action="RETAIN; consider a more specific child term for apical extracellular matrix / cuticle",
      curator_note="Candidate refinement: GO:0060429-adjacent cuticle/apical ECM CC terms."),
 dict(go_id="GO:0071855",aspect="MF",term="neuropeptide receptor binding",current_evidence="ISM",
      reference="PMID:11717458",assigned_by="WB",
      finding="Two independent in vivo studies place NLP-29 upstream of the GPCR NPR-12 (PMID:29301098 dendrite degeneration; PMID:33259791 sleep). No cell-free binding or heterologous NPR-12 activation assay with defined NLP-29 peptides was found.",
      lead_action="RETAIN and UPGRADE evidence from ISM to genetic/IGI-supported; consider adding BP terms for the NPR-12 axis",
      curator_note="Upgrade is a lead: the genetics are epistatic, not a direct binding demonstration."),
])
go_tbl.to_csv("provenance/nlp29_GO_decision_table.csv",index=False)

ev=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(citation="PMID:15048112",year=2004,evidence_type="expression / mutant phenotype",stance="qualifies",
   claim="NLP-29 is an infection-inducible antimicrobial peptide",
   finding="NLP-29 and NLP-31 transcripts induced by fungal and bacterial infection, tir-1 dependent. In vitro antifungal activity demonstrated for synthetic NLP-31.",
   context="C. elegans whole animal; D. coniospora and S. marcescens",
   confidence="high for induction, not gene-specific for activity"),
 dict(citation="PMID:18636113",year=2008,evidence_type="mutant phenotype / transgene overexpression",stance="refutes (gene-level AMP role)",
   claim="nlp-29 itself confers resistance to fungal infection",
   finding="nlp-29(tm1931) null has no marked change in D. coniospora resistance or lifespan. Resistance benefit comes from overexpressing the entire 6-gene cluster (3-8 fold, p<0.001).",
   context="C. elegans epidermis; D. coniospora survival assay",
   confidence="high; cluster redundancy not excluded"),
 dict(citation="PMID:29301098",year=2018,evidence_type="genetic interaction / receptor identification",stance="supports (receptor signalling)",
   claim="NLP-29 acts through a neuronal GPCR",
   finding="NPR-12 acts in neurons as a receptor for NLP-29; autophagy acts cell-autonomously downstream to drive dendrite degeneration in aging and fungal infection.",
   context="C. elegans PVD neurons; aging and D. coniospora infection",
   confidence="high in vivo; no cell-free binding assay reported"),
 dict(citation="PMID:33259791",year=2021,evidence_type="genetic interaction / circuit",stance="supports (receptor signalling)",
   claim="Epidermal NLP-29 signals to the nervous system",
   finding="NLP-29 acts through NPR-12 in locomotion neurons presynaptic to RIS, depolarizing RIS to induce sleep after wounding and infection.",
   context="C. elegans epidermis to RIS neuron; molting and adult injury",
   confidence="high in vivo; independent replication of the NPR-12 link"),
 dict(citation="PMID:40226512",year=2025,evidence_type="localization (knock-in translational reporter)",stance="supports CC, not MF",
   claim="NLP-29 protein is secreted",
   finding="NLP-29::mKate2 knock-in is secreted into the cuticle upon genetic or physical cuticle damage. No membrane-destabilization assay reported.",
   context="C. elegans epidermis and cuticle",
   confidence="high for secretion; is the NAS source for GO:0140912"),
 dict(citation="UniProtKB:O44664",year=2025,evidence_type="database record",stance="qualifies",
   claim="NLP-29 yields six amidated mature peptides",
   finding="All 6 Peptide and 6 amidation features are ECO:0000255 (predicted); protein existence PE=2 (transcript level). FUNCTION line asserts antibacterial and antifungal activity.",
   context="database annotation",
   confidence="prediction only; FUNCTION line exceeds gene-specific primary evidence"),
 dict(citation="this analysis",year=2026,evidence_type="computational",stance="supports",
   claim="Mature NLP-29 peptides are physicochemically incompatible with membrane lysis",
   finding="6-8 aa, zero cationic side chains, net +0.99, muH 0.045-0.236, Gly+Pro 0.43-0.63, P(membrane-lytic)=0.047-0.071 vs lytic benchmark median 0.814 (LOO acc 0.77). Nearest neighbours are Met/Leu-enkephalin.",
   context="in silico; 12 lytic AMPs, 4 non-lytic AMPs, 14 receptor neuropeptides",
   confidence="descriptor-based; conditional on complete processing"),
 dict(citation="this analysis",year=2026,evidence_type="computational",stance="competing",
   claim="The unprocessed pro-region could be membrane-active",
   finding="NLP-29 pro-region 23-73: net charge +5.98, muH 0.422, P(membrane-lytic)=0.976. NLP-31 pro-region +3.98, P=0.916. Europe PMC full-text search for QWGYGGY/GMYGGY/GYGGYGGY returned 0 hits.",
   context="in silico",
   confidence="shows the conclusion is conditional on the processing step, which is unmeasured"),
])
ev.to_csv("provenance/nlp29_evidence_matrix.csv",index=False)
print("Artifacts written:")
for f in sorted(os.listdir("provenance")): print("  provenance/"+f)
print("\n=== GO decision table ===")
print(go_tbl[["go_id","aspect","term","current_evidence","reference","lead_action"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\n=== Evidence matrix (stance counts) ===")
print(ev.stance.value_counts().to_string())
